history.changelog: Initial MVP, transcribed from the working Google Doc.

Adds Article 10 (Freedom From Algorithmic Discrimination) and Article 11 (A Right to Safe, Tested Systems), and revises the wording of Articles 1-9. Every article now closes with its pull quote, so the canonical text and the homepage say the same thing. Articles 5, 7 and 11 gained sentences; no article lost any.
